notes:
IDENTITY CONFIRMED ON FOUR ASSIGNED FACTS. Name (Naresh Kumar K L, the initials retained exactly as in the workbook), specialty (Cardiothoracic Surgery), hospital (AIG Hospitals) and branch/city (Gachibowli, Hyderabad) are carried together in single result titles: 'Dr. Naresh Kumar K L - Cardiothoracic Surgeon in Gachibowli, Hyderabad' (Practo) and 'Dr. Naresh Kumar.K.L, Cardio Thoracic Surgeon | Hyderabad' (Skedoc), the latter stating he has been 'Consultant Cardio Thoracic Surgeon at AIG Hospital, Gachibowli since July 2018'. His own website independently states 'Dr Naresh Kumar is a well experienced Cardiothoracic Surgeon practising at AIG Hospitals, Hyderabad', and HexaHealth carries him on its list of cardiothoracic and vascular surgeons AT AIG Hospital Gachibowli. Qualification fingerprint used to bind the sources together: MBBS 2008, MS General Surgery 2012, MCh Cardiothoracic Surgery NIMS Hyderabad 2015, plus training at Leipzig Heart Centre, Germany.

SAME-NAME DISAMBIGUATION - THREE DIFFERENT HYDERABAD DOCTORS, NONE MERGED. (1) THIS doctor: Dr. Naresh Kumar K L, AIG Gachibowli, ~12 years, MCh NIMS 2015, own site drnareshkumar.co.in. (2) Dr. Naresh Kumar P V (also rendered P.V. Naresh Kumar): a DIFFERENT and much more senior cardiothoracic and vascular surgeon at APOLLO Hospitals Hyderabad with 'over 25 years of experience', his own separate website pvnaresh.com, and pages at apollohospitals.com and apollo247.com. He is the single most dangerous confusion here because he shares the same core name, the same city, the same specialty AND also trained at Leipzig Heart Centre - the discriminators are the initials (K L vs P V), the hospital group (AIG vs Apollo), the experience level (12 vs 25+ years) and the personal domain (drnareshkumar.co.in vs pvnaresh.com). NOTHING from any Apollo, apollo247, pvnaresh.com or 'P V Naresh Kumar' page has been recorded in this row. (3) A 'Dr. Naresh Kumar' at drnareshkumar.in is an AESTHETIC DERMATOLOGIST AND TRICHOLOGIST - a completely different person on a near-identical domain (.in versus .co.in). The .in domain was deliberately NOT recorded; only the .co.in domain, whose own page copy names AIG Hospitals and cardiothoracic surgery, is recorded as his personal_website. Also excluded: Dr. Naresh Kumar G (neurosurgeon, TX Hospitals), Dr. S. Naresh Kumar (cardiologist), Dr. MP Naresh Kumar and a paediatrician of the same name.

HOSPITAL_PROFILE LEFT BLANK ON PURPOSE. An AIG per-doctor URL for him IS in the search index - https://aighospitals.com/doctors/dr-naresh-kumar/ - but it is returned with the title '404 Page Not Found', i.e. AIG published a page and has since removed or moved it. Recording a dead URL as his official hospital profile would be misleading, and building a replacement in AIG's other URL family would breach the no-construction rule, so the field is empty and the dead URL is logged in other_profiles as evidence only. This is the SECOND AIG row in this dataset to hit exactly this condition (row 1215, Dr. Sridhar Dasu, has the same dead /doctors/dr-sridhar-dasu/ URL), which is a pattern worth flagging for the ~360 AIG rows still to come: AIG's older plural /doctors/ URLs are decaying out of the live site while remaining in the search index.

AIG URL PATTERN FINDING (requested explicitly; consistent with and extending the notes recorded on rows 1213-1215). (a) YES - aighospitals.com publishes per-doctor profile pages and they index well. (b) THE URL FAMILIES OBSERVED VERBATIM IN SEARCH RESULTS, never constructed: [1] SINGULAR and current - https://aighospitals.com/doctor/<dr-name-slug> , confirmed live this session by https://aighospitals.com/doctor/dr-c-sukesh-kumar-reddy , https://aighospitals.com/doctor/dr-c-narasimhan , https://aighospitals.com/doctor/dr-sumana-kolar-ramachandra and https://aighospitals.com/doctor/dr-ravi-babu-komalla ; [2] PLURAL and legacy - https://aighospitals.com/doctors/<dr-name-slug> , still serving some doctors (e.g. https://aighospitals.com/doctors/dr-p-balachandran-menon ) but now 404 for others (this doctor, and Dr. Sridhar Dasu); [3] https://aighospitals.com/doctor-profile/<dr-name-slug> , a third family also live (e.g. https://aighospitals.com/doctor-profile/dr-p-balachandran-menon and the row-1214 page https://aighospitals.com/doctor-profile/dr-vamshi-krishna-m ). Slugs are 'dr-' prefixed and are name-only. (c) THE PER-DOCTOR SLUG ENCODES NEITHER DEPARTMENT NOR BRANCH - unlike CARE and Yashoda, AIG's doctor URL is purely the name, so a doctor URL alone can never prove which branch or department someone belongs to; department and branch must be read off other page families. Branch and speciality ARE encoded elsewhere: speciality pages take the form https://aighospitals.com/speciality/<speciality-slug> with an OPTIONAL leading branch segment, e.g. https://aighospitals.com/gcb/speciality/liver-transplant-hepatobiliary-surgery where 'gcb' = Gachibowli, alongside branch-prefixed section roots such as https://aighospitals.com/banjara-hills/ . The doctor directory also supports numeric speciality filters, https://aighospitals.com/doctors?speciality=<id> (ids 20, 28, 33 and 34 observed), and there is a search page at https://www.aighospitals.com/doctor-search . Both the bare aighospitals.com and www.aighospitals.com hostnames are returned by the index; record whichever form the result actually showed. PRACTICAL RULE FOR LATER AIG ROWS: query the doctor's name plus 'AIG' with allowed_domains=['aighospitals.com'], accept whichever of the three families comes back, and always check the returned TITLE - a '404 Page Not Found' title means the URL is dead and must not be recorded as hospital_profile.

CONTACT STATUS: no email, no phone, no WhatsApp and no secretary line is published for him on any page that surfaced across five queries, including a domain-restricted query against his own website. professional_email and professional_phone are therefore blank rather than guessed. A human with page access should open https://drnareshkumar.co.in/ and look for a contact/appointment page - an eponymous marketing site of this kind almost always publishes a number, and rule 4 would permit recording it once seen. REJECTED WITHOUT FOLLOW-UP: the JustDial listing https://www.justdial.com/Hyderabad/Dr-Naresh-Kumar-K-L-Aig-Hospitals-Gachibowli/040PXX40-XX40-191204030821-M3F5_BZDET (call-tracking proxy number, barred) and a Scribd 'DOCTORS Mobile Numbers List' document that surfaced on one query (scraped list-dump, barred outright).

BAND IS MEDIUM. drnareshkumar.co.in is primary self-published and per section 5 can never earn High; aighospitals.com does confirm the department but has no live page for him; Practo, Skedoc, DocIndia, myUpchar and HexaHealth are corroborating-only. No government registry, university or ORCID source was found. The evidence that he is AIG Gachibowli cardiothoracic is nonetheless strong and consistent across five independent sites, so this is Enriched, not Needs Human Review.
